RIMEDANCERMOD-CRYONITE_SHARD.description: At the start of each combat, [gold]Channel[/gold] [blue]{Icicles}[/blue] [gold]Icicle[/gold].
RIMEDANCERMOD-CRYONITE_SHARD.flavor: A crude self sharpening blade, wounds it causes are slow to heal due to the blades chill limiting blood flow and letting the wound fester longer
RIMEDANCERMOD-CRYONITE_SHARD.title: Cryonite Shard
RIMEDANCERMOD-SCROLLOF_WINTER.descriptio: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{Fervor}[/blue] [gold]Fervor[/gold], [gold]Channel[/gold] [blue]{Icicles}[/blue] [gold]Icicle[/gold].
RIMEDANCERMOD-SCROLLOF_WINTER.flavor: An old tattered parchment used by the agents of subterfuge and sabotage of the Wailing Peaks, it's imbued with the wisdom of long since passed elders.
RIMEDANCERMOD-SCROLLOF_WINTER.title: Scroll of Winter
